interpreted_request: 搜索 Java Agent 框架，重点比较 langchain4j/langchain4j 与 alibaba/spring-ai-alibaba 的技术栈与使用方式，并给出来源证据。

candidates.summary: 面向 JVM 的惯用 Java LLM 库，提供统一模型/向量库 API，工具箱覆盖 prompt 模板、chat memory、function calling 到 Agents 与 RAG；agentic 模块以 @Agent 注解声明式定义 agent。

claims.text: README 声明其目标是简化 LLM 集成，提供统一 API，支持 20+ LLM 提供商与 30+ embedding store。
README 明确 LangChain4j 不是 Python LangChain 的移植，而是围绕 Java 惯例（类型安全、POJO、注解、接口、DI、流式 API）从零设计，并与 Quarkus、Spring Boot、Helidon、Micronaut 集成。
源码中 @Agent 是标注在 Java 方法上的运行时注解，方法即 agent，可被其他 agent 调用，支持 name/description/outputKey/typedOutputKey 等属性。

assessments.reason: README 将 Agents 列为工具箱中的高层模式，且存在 langchain4j-agentic 模块的 @Agent 注解源码。
Java 库，Maven 发布（dev.langchain4j），可独立使用或集成 Quarkus/Spring Boot/Helidon/Micronaut。
以 Java 注解/接口声明 agent（@Agent 标注方法），并提供 plain Java、Quarkus、Spring Boot 等示例入口。

candidates.decision_reason: 满足 Java Agent 框架定位，技术栈为纯 Java 库、框架无关，使用方式为注解式声明 agent；维护活跃（当日提交、近期发布）。
unknowns: 未实测 agent 编排性能与运行时行为
未读取 pom.xml 确认最低 JDK 版本

candidates.summary: 基于 Spring AI 的 Agentic AI 框架，由 Agent Framework、Graph 运行时与 Admin 平台组成，内置多智能体编排模式、上下文工程、A2A 与 MCP 支持，通过 Spring Boot starter 与 YAML 配置使用。

claims.text: README 定位为构建 Agentic、Workflow 与多智能体应用的生产级框架，内置 SequentialAgent/ParallelAgent/RoutingAgent/LoopAgent 等编排模式。
README 说明 Graph 是 Agent Framework 的底层运行时，提供持久化、工作流编排与流式能力；项目含 agent-framework、graph、admin、studio、spring-boot-starters 模块。
使用方式为 Spring Boot：引入 spring-ai-alibaba-agent-framework 与 spring-ai-alibaba-starter-dashscope 依赖，要求 JDK 17+，示例通过 ./mvnw -pl examples/chatbot spring-boot:run 启动。
示例 application.yml 通过 spring.ai.dashscope 配置 api-key 与 qwen-plus 模型，并配置 spring.ai.mcp.client（streamable-http/sse）及 spring.ai.alibaba.a2a.nacos 服务发现与注册。

assessments.reason: README 明确为 Agentic AI 框架，含 Agent Framework 与多智能体编排模式。
Java + Spring Boot + Spring AI 生态，依赖 Maven 坐标 com.alibaba.cloud.ai，要求 JDK 17+。
以 Spring Boot starter 依赖 + application.yml 配置（模型、MCP、A2A/Nacos）方式使用，另有 Admin 可视化平台。

candidates.decision_reason: 满足 Java Agent 框架定位，技术栈绑定 Spring AI/Spring Boot，使用方式为 starter + YAML 配置；维护窗口内仍有提交，但最近一次提交距今天约 36 天，最新发布为预发布版。
unknowns: 未实测 Graph 运行时与多智能体编排性能
未读取 pom.xml 确认具体 Spring AI 版本依赖
Admin 平台独立部署效果未验证

conclusion: 两者均为 Java Agent 框架且维护在窗口内。langchain4j 是框架无关的纯 Java 库，以 @Agent 注解/接口声明 agent，可独立或嵌入 Quarkus/Spring Boot 等；spring-ai-alibaba 深度绑定 Spring AI/Spring Boot，以 starter 依赖 + YAML 配置驱动，并提供 Graph 运行时、多智能体编排模式、A2A/MCP 与 Admin 可视化平台。若项目已在 Spring Boot 且需要图编排与平台化能力，后者更贴合；若需轻量、框架无关的 Java 库，前者更合适。性能与运行效果均未实测。
unknowns: 未运行任何示例，性能与稳定性未实测

1: # LangChain4j: idiomatic, open-source Java library for building LLM-powered applications on the JVM
2:

5: [![CODACY](https://img.shields.io/badge/Codacy-Dashboard-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=codacy)](https://app.codacy.com/gh/langchain4j/langchain4j/dashboard)

8: [![BlueSky](https://img.shields.io/badge/@langchain4j-follow-blue?logo=bluesky&style=for-the-badge)](https://bsky.app/profile/langchain4j.dev)
9: [![X](https://img.shields.io/badge/@langchain4j-follow-blue?logo=x&style=for-the-badge)](https://x.com/langchain4j)
10: [![Maven Version](https://img.shields.io/maven-central/v/dev.langchain4j/langchain4j?logo=apachemaven&style=for-the-badge)](https://search.maven.org/#search|gav|1|g:"dev.langchain4j"%20AND%20a:"langchain4j")
11: 
12: 
13: ## Introduction
14: 
15: Welcome!
16: 
17: The goal of LangChain4j is to simplify integrating LLMs into Java applications.
18: 
19: Here's how:
20: 1. **Unified APIs:**
21:    LLM providers (like OpenAI or Google Vertex AI) and embedding (vector) stores (such as Pinecone or Milvus)
22:    use proprietary APIs. LangChain4j offers a unified API to avoid the need for learning and implementing specific APIs for each of them.
23:    To experiment with different LLMs or embedding stores, you can easily switch between them without the need to rewrite your code.
24:    LangChain4j currently supports [20+ popular LLM providers](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/integrations/language-models/)
25:    and [30+ embedding stores](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/integrations/embedding-stores/).
26: 2. **Comprehensive Toolbox:**
27:    Since early 2023, the community has been building numerous LLM-powered applications,
28:    identifying common abstractions, patterns, and techniques. LangChain4j has refined these into practical code.
29:    Our toolbox includes tools ranging from low-level prompt templating, chat memory management, and function calling
30:    to high-level patterns like Agents and RAG.
31:    For each abstraction, we provide an interface along with multiple ready-to-use implementations based on common techniques.
32:    Whether you're building a chatbot or developing a RAG with a complete pipeline from data ingestion to retrieval,
33:    LangChain4j offers a wide variety of options.
34: 3. **Numerous Examples:**
35:    These [examples](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples) showcase how to begin creating various LLM-powered applications,
36:    providing inspiration and enabling you to start building quickly.
37: 
38: LangChain4j began development in early 2023 amid the ChatGPT hype.
39: We noticed a lack of Java counterparts to the numerous Python and JavaScript LLM libraries and frameworks,
40: and we had to fix that!
41: 
42: **Despite the name, LangChain4j is not a Java port of LangChain (Python) — it is built for Java, not ported to it.**
43: It is an idiomatic Java library designed from the ground up around Java conventions:
44: type safety, POJOs, annotations, interfaces, dependency injection, fluent APIs, and first-class integrations with Quarkus, Spring Boot, Helidon, and Micronaut.
45: Its API, internals, and release cycle are independent of the Python LangChain project.
46: 
47: We actively monitor community developments, aiming to quickly incorporate new techniques and integrations,
48: ensuring you stay up-to-date.
49: The library is under active development. While some features are still being worked on,
50: the core functionality is in place, allowing you to start building LLM-powered apps now!
51: 
52: 
53: ## Documentation
54: Documentation can be found [here](https://docs.langchain4j.dev).
55: 
56: The documentation chatbot (experimental) can be found [here](https://chat.langchain4j.dev/).
57: 
58: 
59: ## Getting Started
60: Getting started guide can be found [here](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/get-started).
61: 
62: 
63: ## Code Examples
64: Please see examples of how LangChain4j can be used in [langchain4j-examples](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples) repo:
65: - [Examples in plain Java](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples/tree/main/other-examples/src/main/java)
66: - [Examples with Quarkus](https://github.com/quarkiverse/quarkus-langchain4j/tree/main/samples) (uses [quarkus-langchain4j](https://github.com/quarkiverse/quarkus-langchain4j) dependency)
67: - [Example with Spring Boot](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j-examples/tree/main/spring-boot-example/src/main/java/dev/langchain4j/example)
68: - [Examples with Helidon](https://github.com/helidon-io/helidon-examples/tree/helidon-4.x/examples/integrations/langchain4j) (uses [io.helidon.integrations.langchain4j](https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/io.helidon.integrations.langchain4j) dependency)
69: - [Examples with Micronaut](https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-langchain4j/tree/0.3.x/doc-examples/example-openai-java) (uses [micronaut-langchain4j](https://micronaut-projects.github.io/micronaut-langchain4j/latest/guide/) dependency)
70: 
71: ## Useful Materials
72: Useful materials can be found [here](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/useful-materials).
73: 
74: 
75: ## Get Help
76: Please use [Discord](https://discord.gg/JzTFvyjG6R) or [GitHub discussions](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/discussions)
77: to get help.
78: 
79: 
80: ## Request Features
81: Please let us know what features you need by [opening an issue](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/issues/new/choose).
82: 
83: 
84: ## Contribute
85: Contribution guidelines can be found [here](https://github.com/langchain4j/langchain4j/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

1: package dev.langchain4j.agentic; 2: 3: import static java.lang.annotation.ElementType.METHOD; 4: import static java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME; 5: 6: import dev.langchain4j.agentic.declarative.TypedKey; 7: import dev.langchain4j.agentic.observability.AgentListener; 8: import java.lang.annotation.Retention; 9: import java.lang.annotation.Target; 10: 11: /** 12: * Java methods annotated with {@code @Agent} are considered agents that other agents can invoke. 13: */ 14: @Retention(RUNTIME) 15: @Target({METHOD}) 16: public @interface Agent { 17: 18: /** 19: * Name of the agent. If not provided, method name will be used. 20: * 21: * @return name of the agent. 22: */ 23: String name() default ""; 24: 25: /** 26: * Description of the agent. This is an alias of the {@code description} attribute, and it is possible to use either. 27: * It should be clear and descriptive to allow language model to understand the agent's purpose and its intended use. 28: * 29: * @return description of the agent. 30: */ 31: String value() default ""; 32: 33: /** 34: * Description of the agent. This is an alias of the {@code value} attribute, and it is possible to use either. 35: * It should be clear and descriptive to allow language model to understand the agent's purpose and its intended use. 36: * 37: * @return description of the agent. 38: */ 39: String description() default ""; 40: 41: /** 42: * Key of the output variable that will be used to store the result of the agent's invocation. 43: * 44: * @return name of the output variable. 45: */ 46: String outputKey() default ""; 47: 48: /** 49: * Strongly typed key of the output variable that will be used to store 50: * the result of this agent's invocation in the {@link dev.langchain4j.agentic.scope.AgenticScope}. 51: *

52: * This attribute provides a type-safe alternative to {@link #outputKey()}. 53: * Instead of identifying the output variable using a {@link String}, 54: * the output is identified by a class implementing {@link TypedKey}. 55: *

56: * 57: *

58: * The generic type declared by the {@link TypedKey} represents the type 59: * of value associated with the output variable. 60: *

61: * 62: *

63: * For example: 64: *

65: * 66: * 
{@code
67:      * public class Category implements TypedKey {
68:      * }
69:      *
70:      * @Agent(
71:      *         name = "categoryRouter",
72:      *         typedOutputKey = Category.class
73:      * )
74:      * RequestCategory classify(String request);
75:      * }
76: * 77: *

78: * When the agent completes successfully, its returned 79: * {@code RequestCategory} value is stored in the agentic scope using 80: * {@code Category.class} as the typed state key.

11: A production-ready framework for building Agentic, Workflow, and Multi-agent applications. 12:

13:

14: Agent Framework Docs, 15: Graph Docs, 16: Spring AI, 17: Examples. 18:

19: 20: 21: ## Architecture 22: 23:

24: 25:
